title: Foundation control-room shell
description: Objective: build fixture-driven Goals, Board, Node, Approval, Evidence, and Doctor surfaces using the committed truth-presentation kernel. Deliverable: apps/control-room UI modules excluding live data adapters. NOT in scope: graph canvas, client-derived authority, chat channels, or production network connection. Hard dependencies: Runtime contract registry and Foundation executable specification. Owned paths: apps/control-room/** except apps/control-room/src/data/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test.
definitionOfDone: Every truth fact is triple encoded by text, icon, and color with provenance drill-down.
Actions render only from supplied nextAllowedCommands and disconnected/stale fixtures disable mutation.
J1 is operable in the board default without a graph canvas and keyboard/accessibility tests pass.
The focused control-room typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
reopenReason: Governor: both dependencies verified landed. Runtime contract registry DONE; Foundation executable specification's code is committed (packages/testkit/src/foundation tracked — foundation-fakes.ts, foundation-fault-schedule.ts). Highest unlock available: apps/control-room does not exist in git at all, and this task owns that scaffold. Five downstream tasks are waiting on it — Node attempt workspace, Approval decision surfaces, Evidence causal timeline, Recovery doctor console, Canonical goals board — all of which own apps/control-room subpaths and are unplannable until the app exists. ARCHITECT: this is the repo's FIRST frontend package. It owns the React app shape, build tooling, dev server, and first frontend dependency set. Own package.json, tsconfig.json, src root export, AND the pnpm-lock importer explicitly — three packages have shipped missing one of those today.
